Tested on hundreds of people: the same shift, every time, lethargic and depressed turning into optimistic and positive.

Here's the distinction almost nobody draws. Happiness needs something to happen — a party, a gift, a date that goes well. It's a reaction, borrowed from outside you. Bliss doesn't ask for a reason. It's a spring that was already inside you, running regardless of what your circumstances are doing today. One depends on the world cooperating. The other doesn't need its permission.
